notes.title: Build Update #8: 0.1.61 (Demo)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850775/3f213b75db436c9e930eb8faaca391dcc56bf874.png[/img]

Hey, Adventurers!

We’re always working to make Chakana: Gold of the Gods even better, and we’re thrilled to bring you some exciting updates to enhance your gameplay experience:

Improvements:

[list]
[*] Enhanced Enemy and Final Boss Damage Feedback: We've upgraded the visual and gameplay effects when dealing damage, making each hit feel more impactful.
[*] Dramatic Pause for Final Boss Finisher: Experience an epic, cinematic moment with a new dramatic pause when you land the finishing blow on the final boss.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Spear Ability Area Adjustments: We’ve fine-tuned the lance’s area of effect to ensure smoother and more accurate combat.
[*] Sound Level Balancing: We’ve adjusted the levels of our updated soundtrack, so you can fully immerse yourself in the improved audio design.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued feedback and support! It’s your input that helps us shape Chakana: Gold of the Gods into the best game it can be.

- The Equinoxis Studios Team

notes.title: Build Update #7: 0.1.60 (Demo)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850775/8656d444c0af7ee87b47c4306ec195f381a064d4.png[/img]

Hello, Adventurers!

Your feedback is crucial to the growth of Chakana: Gold of the Gods, and we're always working hard to make sure your experience is the best it can be. After listening to the community, we've made several updates and bug fixes that we’re excited to share.

New Improvements:

[list]
[*] Revamped Visual Effects for Skills and Attacks: Expect a fresh, more vibrant look with our newly redesigned VFX for all abilities and combat moves, adding intensity to every encounter.

[*] Reimagined Gameplay Soundtrack: We’ve given the gameplay music a complete makeover, crafting an atmosphere that better reflects the epic nature of your journey through the world of Chakana.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Look Up/Look Down Control Issue: Fixed problems with the vertical camera control, ensuring smoother gameplay when shifting your view.
[/list]

We remain fully committed to making Chakana: Gold of the Gods an unforgettable adventure. Your feedback plays a huge role in shaping the game, and we’re eager to hear what you think about these updates.

Thanks for being part of this journey with us!

- The Equinoxis Studios Team

notes.title: Exciting Updates to Chakana: Gold of the Gods After Gamescom Latam 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850775/91835ca9ba3c5f7ba83ead56f906d08b4f93531b.png[/img]

Hello, Adventurers!

We have some exciting news to share with our wonderful community. After an incredible experience at 
Gamescom Latam 2024 in São Paulo, we've gathered valuable feedback from players, publishers, and 
industry experts. We're thrilled to announce a series of improvements and modifications to Chakana: 
Gold of the Gods based on this feedback.

What's New:
[list]
[*] Tutorial Enhancements: Players will now start the game with a weapon, providing a more engaging 
[*] and strategic introduction to the adventure.
[*] Jump Mechanics: We've added a "coyote time" feature, allowing for more forgiving and fluid jumping, 
[*] enhancing overall gameplay.
[*] Player Physics: Adjustments have been made to the player's weight and gravity for a more balanced 
[*] feel.
[*] UI Improvements: The skills and health UI has been revamped to clearly indicate when abilities or 
[*] health are available, ensuring players can easily keep track of their status.
[*] Gameplay Visuals: We've improved the visibility of altars and checkpoints to enhance navigation and 
[*] gameplay flow.
[*] Logo Readability: The "Chakana" logo has been refined for better visibility and brand recognition.
[*] Enemy Balance: The health of enemies in the first scenario has been adjusted to provide a more 
[*] balanced challenge.
[*] 
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Spear Skill VFX: Fixed an issue where the VFX for a full spear skill container would disappear when 
[*] transitioning between scenes.
[*] Parachute Jump: Resolved issues with the parachute jump mechanics for smoother operation.
[*] Enemy Teleportation: Addressed teleportation problems with the Boraro and Mapinguari, ensuring 
[*] consistent enemy behavior.
[/list]
We're immensely grateful to everyone who shared their thoughts and suggestions with us. Your support 
and feedback are invaluable as we continue to evolve and enhance Chakana: Gold of the Gods.

We hope you enjoy these updates, and we look forward to hearing more from you. 

Thank you for being a part of our journey!

Happy adventuring!

The Equinoxis Studios Team

notes.title: Build Update #1: 0.1.52 (Demo)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850775/0fa16563e0976c75b07c8e6f0710b6f77ff3a3ae.png[/img]

[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We'd like to express our sincere gratitude for your ongoing support and feedback. Your input is incredibly valuable to us! [b]New Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Introduction of a basic save system, allowing players to save their progress at checkpoints and resume the game when exiting.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where hitting Tzantzas enemies did not inflict damage.
[*] Tweaked and balanced Hoyustus' jumping mechanics and physics.
[*] Adjusted Ukuku's collider for improved gameplay.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Updated gamepad controls for smoother gameplay, aiming to achieve a fluid, fast, and dynamic gaming experience.
[*] Revised keyboard controls configuration (WASD) for improved usability.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy these updates and look forward to hearing your thoughts.

Best regards.
